headline: Reserve Bank of Australia Raises Cash Rate to 18-Year High
summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia increased its cash rate to its highest level in 18 years in a majority board decision aimed at dampening inflation and warding off price pressures. The move is expected to impact mortgage borrowers, savers, and overseas travellers.
why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets monetary policy to maintain economic stability and control inflation. Adjustments to the cash rate directly influence commercial lending rates, consumer borrowing costs, and the valuation of the Australian dollar.

impacts.why: Higher interest rates tighten monetary conditions in the country.
